notes.title: 07-08-18 v1.1 Update
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone out there who bought PUSH on the Steam Summer Sale!

-fixed a glitch where the sidebar would disappear
-fixed an issue with levels 8-4 and 8-8 (thanks @IHNN1 and @Hornlitz)
-figured out how to update the game without deleting your saves
-thought more about the level select

Let me know if you run into any issues, and follow me @abraxasinteract for news about other things I'm working on, and to talk or whatever.
